attchmntText: Rama Phosphates Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Presentation for Quarter Ended September 30, 2026'.
voiceSummary: Rama Phosphates Limited submitted its investor presentation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported record quarterly revenue of Rs. 29,551 Lacs, up 20.3% year-on-year. Profit before tax stood at Rs. 2,624 Lacs, while profit after tax was Rs. 1,917 Lacs. Earnings per share were Rs. 5.42. The trial run of the Single Super Phosphate plant at the Dhule facility was successfully conducted. Statutory approvals for the Dhule plant are awaited. The company highlighted a subsidy increase to Rs. 11,724 per MT for the second half of FY27. New plant projects in Udaipur are expected to be commissioned in the last week of November 2026. The presentation includes financial summaries and balance sheet data as of September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Rama Phosphates Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Rama Phosphates Limited has appointed Mr. Harshvardhan Tarkas as its Secretarial Auditor to fill the casual vacancy caused by the demise of Mr. Ashok Patel. The Board of Directors approved this appointment on November 13, 2026, based on the Audit Committee's recommendation. Mr. Tarkas holds Certificate of Practice number 24169 and Peer Review Firm number 5745/2024. He will serve from November 13, 2026, until the conclusion of the next Annual General Meeting. His tenure covers the secretarial audit for the financial year 2026-2027. The outgoing auditor was M/s. Ashok Patel & Associates. The meeting commenced at 11.00 a.m. and concluded at 12.55 p.m. on the same date. The Chairman and Managing Director, Haresh Doulat Ramsinghani, signed the disclosure. This announcement is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Rama Phosphates Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 20-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: Rama Phosphates Limited has approved a first interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share for the financial year 2026-2027. This represents a 10% payout on the face value of Rs. 5 per share. The dividend will be paid on or after December 08, 2026. Eligibility is determined by the Register of Members as on the record date, which is Friday, November 20, 2026. The announcement was issued by Chairman and Managing Director Harsh D. Ramsinghani on November 13, 2026. The company's CIN is L2411OMH1IS84PLC033917. The scrip code is 524037 and the symbol is RAMAPHO.

attchmntText: Rama Phosphates Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 13, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share.
voiceSummary: Rama Phosphates Limited reported a net profit of 1916.76 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 3623.20 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved a first interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share, payable on or after December 08, 2026, to shareholders on the record date of November 20, 2026. The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change granted the Standard Terms of Reference for the proposed expansion of the Nardana facility, with final Environmental Clearance pending. The expansion targets aggregate annual capacities of 3,00,000 TPA for Single Super Phosphate and Urea-SSP Complex, 1,44,000 TPA for Phosphoric Acid, 1,80,000 TPA for Complex Fertilizer, and 2,16,000 TPA for Sulphuric Acid and Oleum. Mr. Harshvardhan Tarkas was appointed as Secretarial Auditor to fill the casual vacancy.

attchmntText: Rama Phosphates Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rama Phosphates Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations stood at 29,551.48 lacs for the quarter and 43,597.08 lacs for the half year. Profit before tax was 2,623.92 lacs for the quarter and 4,905.15 lacs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 5.42 rupees for the quarter and 10.24 rupees for the half year. The Board recommended an interim dividend of Rs 0.50 per equity share. The company commenced trial production of Single Super Phosphate fertilizer on November 11, 2026, at its Nardana facility. Total SSP production capacity is now 9.14 lakh metric tons per annum. Phase II activities have also started. The statutory auditor conducted a limited review of the results.

attchmntText: Rama Phosphates Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Commencement of Trial Production for Phase-I (SSP Plant) at Nardana (Dhule), Maharashtra'.
voiceSummary: Rama Phosphates Limited has commenced trial production of Single Super Phosphate fertilizer under Phase-I of its greenfield manufacturing facility at Nardana in Dhule, Maharashtra. The company expects to initiate full-scale commercial production shortly after receiving requisite approvals from statutory authorities. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The announcement was issued on November 12, 2026. It was signed by Haresh D. Ramsinghani, Chairman and Managing Director, with DIN 00035416. The stock symbol is RAMAPHO and the scrip code is 524037.
